ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High intensity contrast; approximately 65% high-intensity white/light-gray pixels concentrated in lobe centers versus 35% low-intensity black/dark-gray pixels localized at the perimeter and notch.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary white contiguous zones occupy the medial-to-lateral expanse of both lobes. Significant black mottling and dendritic patterns extend from the leading edge and trailing edge into the white fields. Discrete black speckling (point-noise distribution) is scattered across the central white areas.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a pixel angle approximately between 40 and 55 degrees, showing a clean separation between the inner lobe boundaries.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile; pixel-amplitude variations (peaks and valleys) are most pronounced on the lateral thirds of both trailing edges, exhibiting a jagged, non-linear boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature from the median notch extending laterally to a tapered, slightly upward-curving tip on both the left and right lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast, three-dimensional calcified formations (barnacle colonization) are visible at the distal tips and along segments of the trailing edge topography.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Short, dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions resembling rake marks are visible on the lower-medial white regions of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive epibiont (barnacle) colonization localized on the outer fluke tips; several small, circular dark-pigmented pockmarks visible within the white ventral fields.
other_distinctive_markers: Dynamic water occlusion and high-intensity white-water spray obscuring the insertion point of the fluke into the peduncle area.
